AssemblyIdentifierClassName.description: Name of the generated assembly identifier marker class. No default: derived from the project name with NamespacePrefix removed and dots stripped, suffixed with Assembly.

AutoGeneratedAssemblyIdentifierFile.description: File name of the generated assembly identifier source file, written under the intermediate Properties/ folder.

AutoGeneratedAssemblyInfoFile.description: File name of the generated AssemblyInfo helper source file, written under the intermediate Properties/ folder.

AutoIncludeUsings.description: Adds global usings for NamespacePrefix and RootNamespace.

BootstrapEditorConfigToRepoRoot.description: Copies the SDK's .editorconfig to RepositoryEditorConfigFilePath when that file is missing.

BootstrapGlobalJsonToRepoRoot.description: Creates global.json at RepositoryGlobalJsonFilePath when it is missing, pinning msbuild-sdks.Purview.BuildSdk.

BootstrapMultiThreadedBuildRspToRepoRoot.description: Creates a managed Directory.Build.rsp at the repository root that enables MSBuild's multithreaded build (-mt) on .NET 11.

CurrentYear.description: Year used in generated assembly metadata. No default: the current year at build time.

DisableAutoCopySdkFiles.description: Master switch that turns off every repository bootstrap (.editorconfig, global.json, Directory.Build.rsp).

DisableAutoInternalsVisibleTo.description: Turns off the generated InternalsVisibleTo entries for test and shared-testing projects.

DisableGenerateAssemblyIdentifierClass.description: Turns off the generated assembly identifier marker class. True for test and shared-testing projects.

DisableGenerateAssemblyInfoClass.description: Turns off the generated AssemblyInfo helper source.

DisableNamespacePrefixCheck.description: Suppresses the build error raised when NamespacePrefix is not set.

DisableProjectFileNamingConventionCheck.description: Turns off the check that a project file is named after its folder (MyProject/MyProject.csproj).

DisablePurviewBlazorWebAssemblyDefaults.description: Keeps the generic defaults on a Blazor WebAssembly client (packable when asked, container detection, the automatic Shared reference). A ServerShared project is never added either way. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

DisablePurviewBrowserSafeReferenceCheck.description: Turns off PRBLZ0001, the check that a Blazor WebAssembly client's (or browser-safe library's) project references set PurviewBrowserSafe. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

DisablePurviewServerSharedReferenceCheck.description: Turns off PRSHR0001/PRSHR0002, which report a ServerShared reference from a client-side or Shared project. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

DisablePurviewStylePolicyValidation.description: Stops PRSGD0006-PRSGD0009 failing the build when the repository .editorconfig or NoWarn weakens the style policy.

DisablePurviewTestContextRuleSet.description: Makes test and shared-testing projects enforce the production API-surface rules too, instead of exempting PurviewTestContextNoWarn. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

DisableRoslynCompilerDefaultsValidation.description: Stops ValidateRoslynComponentCompilerSettings failing the pack of a Roslyn component whose compiler defaults were changed.

DisableSourceLink.description: Stops the SDK adding the SourceLink package at all.

DisableUnconditionalProjectDeclarationCh.description: Suppresses PurviewConditionedProjectDeclaration, raised when IsRoslynComponent, IsRoslynComponentOnly, IsPackable, PurviewTargetFrameworkSet or RootNamespace is declared only under a Condition the SDK cannot evaluate.

EditorConfigFilePath.description: The SDK-provided .editorconfig injected into EditorConfigFiles for build-time style enforcement. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: the .editorconfig inside the installed SDK package.

EnableAssemblyNameGeneration.description: Derives AssemblyName and PackageId from the evaluated RootNamespace. False restores the standard .NET behaviour (the project name). An explicit AssemblyName or PackageId always wins. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

EnablePurviewPropertySchemaValidation.description: Runs ValidatePurviewPropertySchema before Pack, failing it when a .buildschema.json sidecar and the package's .props/.targets disagree (PRPSC0001-PRPSC0004). For a package that ships MSBuild properties. Off, so no ordinary build or pack changes.

EnableVersionDetectionCache.description: Caches auto-discovered package.json version results locally. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

ExcludeMSTelemetryExtension.description: Excludes Microsoft.Extensions.Telemetry.Abstractions. Only relevant while ExcludePurviewTelemetry is false.

ExcludePurviewTelemetry.description: Excludes Purview.Telemetry.SourceGenerator (and with it the whole telemetry package group) from every project. True for Roslyn components.

IsAspireHostProject.description: True when the project SDK starts with Aspire.Sdk.Host or Aspire.AppHost.Sdk. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to override. No default: detected from the project.

IsBffProject.description: True for a web SDK project whose name ends with Bff; set it to true or false to override. Gates the PDS0008/PDS0009 analyzers. No default: detected from the project.

IsBlazorHostProject.description: True for a web SDK project that references a Blazor WebAssembly client. Says nothing about whether the host is a BFF. No default: detected from the project.

IsBlazorWebAssemblyProject.description: True when the project SDK is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.BlazorWebAssembly. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to override. No default: detected from the project.

IsCLIProject.description: True when the project name ends with CLI, Console, CommandLine, QuickStart or QuickStarts. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to override. No default: detected from the project.

IsClientSideProject.description: True when the project's assemblies are downloaded to a browser: a WebAssembly client, a PurviewBrowserSafe library, a Razor class library, or a *.Client/*.ClientShared/*.Browser/*.Wasm/*.WebAssembly/*.Components (or ClientShared/Components) name. A ServerShared project is never added to one. Set it to override. No default: detected from the project.

IsContainerProject.description: True when a Dockerfile beside the project selects the container defaults. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to override. No default: detected from the project.

IsCSharpProject.description: True for a .csproj; every C# default in the SDK is gated on it. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: detected from the project file extension.

IsRazorClassLibraryProject.description: True when the project SDK is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Razor. No default: detected from the project.

IsRoslynComponentOnly.description: Produces an analyzer-only package for a Roslyn component: no lib/ output, no symbol package, and the analyzer and its PDB packed under analyzers/dotnet/cs/. True for Roslyn components; set false for a dual-role component. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

IsSdkProject.description: True when an Sdk value is found on the project or its import declaration. No default: detected from the project.

IsServerSharedProject.description: True for a ServerShared helper project (ServerShared, ServerSharedFramework, ...), which only projects that cannot run in a browser reference automatically. No default: detected from the project name.

IsSharedProject.description: True for a Shared helper project (Shared, SharedFramework, ...), which other projects reference automatically. No default: detected from the project name.

IsSharedTestingProject.description: True for a shared testing helper project (SharedTestingFramework, ...). Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: detected from the project name.

IsWebProject.description: Marks a project with web behaviour (a web SDK project or an API host). Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: detected from the project.

IsWebSdkProject.description: True when the project SDK is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: detected from the project.

IsWorkerSdkProject.description: True when the project SDK is Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Worker. No default: detected from the project.

MemorySafetyRules.description: C# 15 memory-safety tier for net11.0+ targets. The updated rules are an experimental compiler feature, so they are opt-in. AllowUnsafeBlocks is never changed. An unrecognised tier fails with PRCFG0001.

NamespacePrefix.description: Required. Root namespace prefix, for example Acme, which turns a project named MyProject into Acme.MyProject. Set it in Directory.Build.props, before the `Sdk.props` import. The build fails without it unless DisableNamespacePrefixCheck is true. No default: every repository chooses its own.

PackProjectReferencedSourceGenerators.description: Packs analyzer ProjectReference outputs and their runtime dependencies under analyzers/dotnet/cs/. Set Pack="false" on one reference to exclude only that generator. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

PurviewAnalyzerClosurePermittedReference.description: Simple-name prefixes of host-provided assemblies an analyzer-closure file may reference without PRSGD0005.

PurviewAutoBlazorClientReference.description: Lets a host named Name reference its Name.Client WebAssembly client automatically.

PurviewAutoSdkPack.description: Packs a packable project's Sdk/ folder into the package, mapping Sdk/build, Sdk/buildTransitive and the rest to their package paths. Disable it for an MSBuild SDK project.

PurviewAutoServerSharedReference.description: Adds ../ServerShared*/ServerShared*.csproj to a project that cannot run in a browser. Client-side projects never get one.

PurviewBffExposesApi.description: Keeps the OpenAPI interceptor namespace on a BFF host. No default: true when the BFF references Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi, otherwise unset.

PurviewBrowserSafe.description: Applies the browser-safe defaults to a class library: IsAotCompatible, SupportedPlatform browser, and trim, AOT and CA1416 diagnostics as errors. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

PurviewBrowserSafeReferenceCheckAsError.description: Reports PRBLZ0001 as an error instead of a warning. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

PurviewBrowserSafeWarningCodes.description: Diagnostics a browser-safe library escalates to errors. No default: on a PurviewBrowserSafe library, CA1416, IL2001-IL2128, IL3000-IL3005 and IL3050-IL3059.

PurviewBrowserSafeWarningsAsErrors.description: When false, a browser-safe library keeps its trim, AOT and CA1416 diagnostics as warnings. No default: true on a PurviewBrowserSafe library, otherwise unset.

PurviewBuildSdkVersionForGlobalJson.description: Version written to msbuild-sdks.Purview.BuildSdk in a bootstrapped global.json. No default: the restored package version, else the version the SDK was packed as.

PurviewEditorConfigAdoptionStampPath.description: Where the once-per-SDK-version record of the .editorconfig adoption warning is kept. No default: .purview/editorconfig-adoption.cache beside the repository .editorconfig.

PurviewEditorConfigAdoptionWarning.description: Warns, once per repository per SDK version, when the repository .editorconfig is not one the SDK manages and so will never be updated.

PurviewEditorConfigAdoptionWarningInCI.description: Reports the .editorconfig adoption warning on CI builds too. Off so that advice cannot fail a TreatWarningsAsErrors build.

PurviewEditorConfigAutoUpdate.description: Refreshes a managed .editorconfig (one opening with the SDK's version marker) when the SDK version changes. False keeps it exactly as it is.

PurviewImportProjectReferenceBuildTransi.description: Registers the CompilerVisibleProperty items a referenced project ships in Sdk/buildTransitive, so a package's own properties reach analyzers while developing it through ProjectReference.

PurviewIncludeComponentReferenceAnalyzer.description: Includes a referenced Roslyn component's analyzer artifact in the referencing component's analyzer closure.

PurviewMultiThreadedBuild.description: When false, a managed Directory.Build.rsp is rewritten to -mt:false so MSBuild's multithreaded build is actually off.

PurviewPackAnalyzerPdb.description: Packs a Roslyn component's PDB beside its analyzer under analyzers/dotnet/cs/, because a .snupkg cannot carry analyzer symbols. No default: true for an analyzer-only Roslyn component, otherwise unset.

PurviewPropertySchemaDirectory.description: Folder whose .props/.targets files and .buildschema.json sidecars ValidatePurviewPropertySchema checks. No default: the project's Sdk/ folder, which PurviewAutoSdkPack ships.

PurviewPropertySchemaIgnoredProperties.description: Compiler-visible properties ValidatePurviewPropertySchema does not require a sidecar entry for, because the package does not own them (Version, RootNamespace, ...). No default: empty.

PurviewRepoBootstrapCopyFailureAsError.description: When false, a bootstrap write that still fails after every retry is a warning instead of an error.

PurviewRepoBootstrapCopyRetries.description: Write attempts before a bootstrap write failure is reported.

PurviewRepoBootstrapCopyRetryDelayMillis.description: Base delay, in milliseconds, between bootstrap write attempts.

PurviewRepoBootstrapMode.description: How the repository bootstrap treats an existing file.

PurviewRepositoryRootMarkers.description: Ordered markers that identify a repository root. The first is definitive and searched to the top; the rest resolve nearest-first. A trailing slash marks a directory. The home directory and above are never candidates.

PurviewRepositoryRootStrategy.description: How the bootstrap finds the repository root.

PurviewRuntimeAsync.description: Compiles net11.0+ targets with <Features>runtime-async=on</Features>. UseRuntimeAsync=true also opts in; an explicit false under either name keeps it off. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

PurviewServerSharedReferenceCheckAsError.description: Reports PRSHR0001/PRSHR0002 as errors instead of warnings.

PurviewSharedTestingOutputType.description: Output type forced on shared-testing projects. Library keeps them helper libraries, with IsTestProject and IsTestingPlatformApplication cleared; Exe keeps the test packages' executable shape.

PurviewSkillsAgents.description: Agents the skill targets install to, separated by commas, semicolons or spaces. When set, CheckPurviewSkills and FixPurviewSkills allow only those agents' skill directories. On a dotnet msbuild command line write a comma as %2C. No default: empty, so the skills CLI auto-detects agents.

PurviewSkillsCommand.description: Replaces the skills CLI launcher entirely, skipping runner detection. No default: detected from PATH (skills, then PurviewSkillsRunner, then PurviewSkillsRunnerCandidates).

PurviewSkillsDryRun.description: Makes InstallPurviewSkills and UpdatePurviewSkills print the skills CLI commands without running them. No default: unset, which is treated as false.

PurviewSkillsInstallRoot.description: Overrides the repository root every skill target runs from. No default: resolved from PurviewRepositoryRootMarkers, CI workspace variables and SourceLink.

PurviewSkillsLockFile.description: Where the skills CLI's lockfile is read from. No default: skills-lock.json at the resolved repository root.

PurviewSkillsPackage.description: Package spec the executed skills CLI launcher pins to.

PurviewSkillsRepoRoot.description: Evaluation-time guess at the repository root for the skill targets; a value you set outranks the marker walk. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: RepoRoot, else the nearest folder with an AGENTS.md.

PurviewSkillsRunner.description: Package runner used to launch the skills CLI. A runner without a known launcher runs as '<runner> skills@1'.

PurviewSkillsRunnerCandidates.description: Runners probed on PATH, in order, after PurviewSkillsRunner.

PurviewSkillsSource.description: The git source InstallPurviewSkills adds through the skills CLI (owner/repo, optionally #ref). No default: unset, which makes InstallPurviewSkills restore skills-lock.json instead.

PurviewSkillsSourceFolder.description: Repository folder holding authored skills. No default: skills/ under PurviewSkillsRepoRoot.

PurviewSourceGeneratorFrameworkAnalyzerV.description: Set to false to turn off PRSGD0005, which checks that every file in a Roslyn component's analyzer closure is self-contained. No default: unset, which is treated as true.

PurviewSuppressCopyRetryWarnings.description: Demotes the built-in copy task's MSB3026 retry notices to messages. A copy that finally fails is still an error.

PurviewTargetFrameworkSet.description: Curated target framework set used when no TargetFramework or TargetFrameworks is set. An explicit TargetFramework(s) always wins. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import, or unconditionally in the project file. An unknown name fails with PurviewInvalidTargetFrameworkSet; a Roslyn component ignores the sets.

PurviewTargetFrameworksAll.description: Frameworks of the All set: Broad plus the newest major. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to redefine the set.

PurviewTargetFrameworksBroad.description: Frameworks of the Broad set: every shipped release, without committing to the newest major. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to redefine the set.

PurviewTargetFrameworksCurrent.description: Frameworks of the Current set, the default: the current LTS plus the latest release. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to redefine the set.

PurviewTargetFrameworksLatest.description: Frameworks of the Latest set: the latest shipped release only. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to redefine the set.

PurviewTargetFrameworksSupported.description: Frameworks of the Supported set: every release still in support. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to redefine the set.

PurviewTestContextNoWarn.description: Rules exempted in test and shared-testing projects, so test classes stay public, Method_Scenario_Expectation names keep their underscores and helpers need no null guards. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to narrow or extend it.

RepoRoot.description: Repository root used for version detection and bootstrapping. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: discovered from CI workspace variables, then a .git marker or package.json above the project.

RepositoryDirectoryBuildRspFilePath.description: Destination of the bootstrapped Directory.Build.rsp. No default: resolved at the repository root.

RepositoryEditorConfigFilePath.description: Destination of the bootstrapped .editorconfig. No default: resolved at the repository root, else beside Directory.Build.props.

RepositoryGlobalJsonFilePath.description: Destination of the bootstrapped global.json. No default: resolved at the repository root, else beside Directory.Build.props.

RootPackageJson.description: Explicit path to the package.json whose version becomes Version and PackageVersion. A relative path resolves from the project directory, so in Directory.Build.props prefer $(MSBuildThisFileDirectory)package.json. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: auto-discovered at the repository root.

SdkProjectName.description: The SDK named by the project or its import, for example Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: detected from the project.

SourceLinkPackageName.description: SourceLink provider package added to every non-test project. Match the repository host, and give it a PackageVersion under Central Package Management.

SubstituteFramework.description: Mocking provider added to test projects. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

TargetProjectName.description: For a test project, the project under test, inferred from the test project's name. No default: detected from the project name.

TestDataFramework.description: Test data provider added to test projects. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

TestingFramework.description: Testing framework wired into test projects. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

TestingType.description: Test category taken from a test project's name suffix (Unit, Integration, E2E, ...). Set it before the `Sdk.props` import to override. No default: detected from the project name.

UsePackageJsonVersion.description: Version detection from package.json: true applies the version field to Version and PackageVersion, false turns it off, and Strict fails the build when no version source can be resolved. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import.

VersionDetectionCacheFile.description: File the package.json version detection cache is written to. Set it before the `Sdk.props` import. No default: one file per project directory under the temporary directory.

VersionDetectionLogEnabled.description: Emits a high-importance message with the detected package version.

values.1: Preview pointer syntax; also selects LangVersion=preview.

purview-package-json-version.description: Whether the version comes from package.json.

values.true: Use the package.json version when one can be found.
values.Strict: Use the package.json version, and fail the build when none can be resolved.

purview-repo-bootstrap-mode.description: How a repository bootstrap treats an existing file.

values.IfMissing: Write the file only when it does not exist.
values.Always: Overwrite the file on every build.
values.WarnOnDrift: Report a file that differs from the SDK's.

purview-repository-root-strategy.description: How the repository root is found.

values.Markers: Walk up to the nearest root marker, without starting a process.
values.Git: Ask git for the worktree root.

purview-shared-testing-output-type.description: The output type of a shared-testing project.

purview-skills-runner.description: A package runner that can launch the skills CLI.

values.Microsoft.SourceLink.AzureDevOpsServer.G: On-premises Azure DevOps Server or TFS.

values.Current: The current LTS plus the latest release.
values.Broad: Every shipped release, without the newest major.
values.All: Every shipped release, including the newest major.
